description:
Lancaster Castle, Manor, 2nd TC then 2nd manor build from RTS_Papercut
Some of the timings corrected with testing - but of course can be a little bit better if executed perfectly than shown here
Have fun!
name: Papercut's 2 TC 2 Manor - Copy for me to understand series
author: murtuk

notes: Leave 3 on @resource/resource_food.webp@ and send others to 5 @resource/resource_stone.webp@1 @resource/resource_wood.webp@
All @resource/resource_wood.webp@vils (7 vil) and age upper (3 vil) go build @building_lancaster/manor.webp@on @resource/resource_wood.webp@then gather@resource/resource_wood.webp@
Stop gathering@resource/resource_stone.webp@ when having 100 extra(700 left on node) (for a 2nd manor)
2nd TC ready, Have at least 5-6 on@resource/resource_food.webp@ to produce from both TC
Make production buildings and respond to enemy

description: All in earls guard timing attack. Perfect counter to aggro and boom. Not ideal for civs that FC.
name: Earl's Guard Rush
author: Valdemar1902

notes: First @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ is out and you can start harassing @resource/resource_gold.png@ & @resource/deer.png@
During the age up you continue to harass and push deer. You will need to split 2:1 ratio food and gold and get to castle right after entering feudal.

3 @unit_lancaster/elitechampion.webp@ spawn with @landmark_english/the-white-tower.png@ finish. Run immediately to your opponent and start blocking production of army and vills, age ups, deny resources, this is the crucial timing.
Go out for @resource/deer.webp@ & @resource/boar.png@ to fuel @unit_lancaster/elitechampion.png@ production.

@unit_worker/villager.webp@6 to @resource/resource_food.webp@ next build @building_economy/house.webp@ and @building_economy/mining-camp.webp@ on @resource/resource_gold.webp@ other 2 on @resource/resource_gold.webp@
3 from gold build @landmark_lancaster/lancaster_castle.webp@ other @unit_worker/villager.webp@ remacro 3 on @resource/resource_food.webp@ 5 on @resource/resource_stone.webp@
@resource/rally.webp@ on @resource/resource_wood.webp@ before 7 and build first @building_lancaster/manor.webp@ on wood
when 450 @resource/resource_stone.webp@ move 5 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ to build second @building_economy/town-center.webp@ and farm wood for another @building_lancaster/manor.webp@
if opponent in feudal all in @unit_worker/villager.webp@,
if opponent fast castle leave 4 @unit_worker/villager.webp@on @resource/resource_wood.webp@ , 18 on @resource/resource_food.webp@, 8 on @resource/resource_gold.webp@
make farms araund @building_lancaster/manor.webp@ and build as u can @building_economy/farm.webp@

author: Azogs_

notes: Tous les vills du @resource/resource_wood.webp@ (7 vil) et ceux du AgeUp (3 vil) vont build @building_lancaster/manor.webp@sur @resource/resource_wood.webp@
Quand on a 400 @resource/resource_wood.webp@ et 300 @resource/resource_stone.webp@ Build le 2nd @building_economy/town-center.webp@
Arrêter de récolter de la @resource/resource_stone.webp@ quand on en a 100 de plus pour le 2nd manoir.
2nd TC terminer : Laisser 6 sur @resource/resource_food.webp@ pour produire en boucle sur les 2 TC
Build le 2nd @building_lancaster/manor.webp@ sur une autre ressource.
Hacemos Lanceros hasta 2 lanceros si no podemos hacer daño
1 Casa. Punto de Reunion en la Madera
Construir Cuartel + Galerias de tiro + Mejora comida

description: 2TC / 1 manor into feudal aggression or FC/White Tower
name: HoL 2TC - Papercut
author: ferg40

notes: Use @landmark_lancaster/lancaster_castle.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @abilities/repair.webp@@building_lancaster/manor.webp@ on @resource/resource_wood.webp@ to cover both TCs
@abilities/repair.webp@@building_economy/town-center.webp@ to secure next food or gold

until 100@resource/resource_stone.webp@/@unit_worker/villager.webp@@resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ and @unit_worker/villager.webp@@resource/resource_stone.webp@ build @building_lancaster/manor.webp@at@resource/resource_wood.webp@total 6 builder rest on @resource/sheep.webp@
With 1 @resource/sheep.webp@ villager build @building_economy/house.webp@ and @building_economy/mining-camp.webp@ with new @resource/resource_gold.webp@ villager
As soon as possible use  @resource/resource_gold.webp@ villager to build @landmark_english/abbey-of-kings.webp@
Send 1 @resource/sheep.webp@ villager and @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ near forum
At 90 @resource/resource_stone.webp@ collected move all @resource/resource_stone.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ near forum

At 225 @resource/resource_wood.webp@ take 2 @resource/resource_wood.webp@villagers and build @building_lancaster/manor.webp@to cover @resource/sheep.webp@ right nect to@resource/resource_wood.webp@treeline (and @resource/resource_gold.webp@ if possible)
@resource/rally.webp@ and move villagers to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ treeline near forum

Produce 1 @unit_lancaster/lord_lancaster.webp@ more then build either @building_military/stable.webp@or@building_military/barracks.webp@or@building_military/archery-range.webp@ and start producing 1 @unit_lancaster/hobelar_age2.webp@

Second @building_military/stable.webp@ (or other finished, start prod more @unit_lancaster/hobelar_age2.webp@, start scouting/attacking around mid map.  @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/resource_gold.webp@
Build @building_military/archery-range.webp@ then @resource/resource_wood.webp@, start producing and harassing. When units are low, pull them back to heal
Produce more @unit_lancaster/lord_lancaster.webp@, start @building_technology/blacksmith.webp@ prepare to switch food source to @resource/deer.webp@ if not already
Queue @technology_military/iron-undermesh.webp@ and prepare to dive at around 09:00 remember to send back wounded troops or whole army
Get @technology_economy/survival-techniques.webp@ and prepare to build @building_economy/market.webp@ around @resource/berrybush.webp@ and expand @resource/deer.webp@
Stop producing units, prepare to ge up to @age/age_3.webp@ Pull @resource/sheep.webp@ to @resource/berrybush.webp@
Dive again for real this time
Build @landmark_lancaster/kings_college.webp@ if a lot of hoblars and if in good position, otherwise White tower possible

Split Age up @unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_stone.webp@and @resource/resource_wood.webp@ also immediately @abilities/repair.webp@@building_lancaster/manor.webp@with 4 @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@

At this point @abilities/repair.webp@@building_military/barracks.webp@@building_military/archery-range.webp@ and @building_technology/blacksmith.webp@. Excess Wood goes into @building_economy/farm.webp@
Aldeanos a oro, Contruir Casa + Mineria con aldeanos de oro
Abadia de Reyes / Defensivo el castillo
2TC Cuando tengo 100 de piedra paso los 4 de piedra al TC
Feudal. Añadimos aldeanos a  Madera + Mejora Madera@technology_economy/double-broadaxe.webp@ + Mejora Comida
